Our process

A clear path from early ideas to a buildable plan

Every project has different conditions, but homeowners should never have to guess what comes next. The process brings scope, decisions, and coordination into one understandable sequence.

Request a consultation Explore services
Call (206) 407-6291

Six phases

What to expect

The exact deliverables and timeline are tailored to the project.

Consultation and fit

Discuss the property, priorities, target timing, and known constraints to determine a practical fit.

Site and scope discovery

Study existing conditions, access, systems, measurements, and likely permitting needs.

Design and selections

Coordinate layouts, materials, fixtures, finish direction, and technical requirements into a buildable plan.

Proposal and preconstruction

Document scope, allowances, exclusions, responsibilities, schedule assumptions, permits, and procurement.

Construction and communication

Organize site protection, trade coordination, progress updates, and approved changes.

Completion and closeout

Review the completed scope, resolve documented closeout items, and transfer available care information.

Before the first meeting

A little preparation makes the consultation more useful

  • Identify the spaces and problems you most want to solve.
  • Collect inspiration that shows preferences, not just trends.
  • Note known property, access, permit, or neighborhood constraints.
  • Consider the investment range and timing that feel realistic.

Explore the work

Match the process to your project type

Each service page explains its scope, materials, and budget factors.

View all services

Ready to define the first step?

Tell us what you want to change and where the property is located.
